scope: Whole original Crab state snapshot and CrabBarn receive/send, composed with its existing Update. Metadata casts, stream lookup/count and state serializer retain explicit boundaries. Caller supplies initialized 120-byte private state scratch; original state field/copy order, ownership gates, preselected sends and per-object timer writes are preserved. Original packet codec, actual network, Crab outer Update and world/animation/GPU ownership remain pending. Full caller arena and ordered service comparisons include repeated metadata casts, snapshot owner/target branches, empty/single/odd/even Barn counts, due/NaN timers, receive local-owner skips, invalid index assertions, callback-modified counts/pointers/history and consecutive Barn Update frames. The count service explicitly supplies original private state scratch bytes; the serializer is a prepared service and no network traffic is emitted. Receive-mode count input is uninitialized by the original caller and represented as undefined in the runtime; the decoder must write it. Only that write-only trace input is normalized to zero; decoded count, maximum, all object bytes and service outputs remain compared. Additional cases cover private scratch seeded with 0/90/255, consecutive reuse and both canonical NaN signs in snapshot SIMD lanes.
